title: Jude and the Hymn
author: Hazel Sterling
blurb: Lena Vane, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
